svg.title: Video Scale S4 BPM workflow — Medium-Large Production
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Medium-Large Production. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Explicit S4 parallel picture/audio/marketing data flow from the production scale framework. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.aria-label: Workflow title, profile and runtime status
g.text: Video Scale S4 · Medium-Large Production BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Run premium picture, sound and marketing lanes with rights-heavy
clearance, optimization and multi-outlet packaging. Music video,
premium brand film, comedy/talk package or label/digital release
G Music Video / E premium DNA. Explicit S4 parallel
picture/audio/marketing data flow from the production scale
L1 required; strict L2; rights + deepfake HiTL; full QC mesh;
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Approve budget and detailed rights register.
• Select premium concept and outlet matrix.
• Sample, likeness and outlet rights are explicit.
Revise budget, rights or outlet ambition.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Plan choreography, casting and production design.
• L1 validates coverage and performance plan.
• Trailer/social work is planned before lock.
Return failed concept, casting or clearance.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Picture: DoP + prompt pool + continuity + VFX.
• Marketing: social moments and campaign capture.
• Cost/latency routing is policy-only until enabled.
• Per-shot QA and provenance are mandatory.
Rerender, rerecord or restage failed lane.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Grade, VFX and final sound converge.
• Full QC mesh spans picture and sound.
Picture lock · final mix · trailer/social assets
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Blocked sample or identity halts release.
Route rights, identity or craft issue.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• LabelDigital and Distributor fan out packages.
• Failed branch does not invalidate ready branches.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Community signals feed the next plan.
Feed tested results into next premium plan.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Explicit S4 parallel picture/audio/marketing data flow from the production scale framework.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 38 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
